{
  "literal": "انهض واطحن",
  "adaptation": "صباحك قهوة ونشاط",
  "back_translation": "Your morning is coffee and energy.",
  "approach": "replaced",
  "notes": "The original pun on 'grind' (work hard / coffee grinding) does not exist in Arabic, so it was replaced with a culturally familiar, rhyming morning greeting that ties coffee to vitality without any negative connotations of labor."
}
back_translation: Your morning is coffee and energy.
notes: The original pun on 'grind' (work hard / coffee grinding) does not exist in Arabic, so it was replaced with a culturally familiar, rhyming morning greeting that ties coffee to vitality without any negative connotations of labor.
